steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: There's no sign of fighting inside the house. The children are still sleeping.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Hyman wouldn't harm the kids. You can be sure of that.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I don't know how long she can maintain her reason.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: How do you intend to tell the kids about Hyman when they wake up?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: They have a right to know.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Sometimes, ignorance is bliss.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Is that a suggestion?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: No, Federico...

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I hope you don't mind me calling you that.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: It was you who spared Hyman. It was you who earned the children's trust. The choice is yours.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Feeling the weight?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I'm not wearing any extra weights.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I'll take that as your personal brand of humor.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: What are you looking at?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Do you know what this is?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: A piece of cloth... we stuff like that to make blankets for winter, but I've never seen this pattern before.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: It's a common Lateran pattern.
Underneath the cloth, the twins' breathing is long and steady.
The Executor looks at it for a while, then turns his gaze to the simple desk beside.
There is a small clay jar on it.
Other than the children, the flower in the jar, not yet fully wilted, provides the only color in the room.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: A flower? It's pretty dried-up. Must have been there for at least two days.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Is this Hyman's hobby?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I... I don't know.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I thought I knew the people who follow me. But I'm not even sure...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I must return to the sacrarium.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I have enough information to pass judgment on the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: And what is your judgment?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: First, there is something I must know—have you had any interaction with Oren Argiolas?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Oren the nuncio?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Not much. He went missing soon after he arrived.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You call yourself Gerald, but that is not your real name.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Who can say if a name is real or not? I've used it for ten years.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I've been Gerald the Hunter ever since we started living here and built our first house with those broken planks.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: How you identify is none of my concern. You can be Gerald.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Then—
A strange sense of urgency causes the words fall from the tongue.
Federico does not give him time to speak.
He says the name that has not been spoken in public for ten years.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: A mercenary who made his name in the Kazdel Civil War, wanted by the Notarial Hall, thirty-two confirmed crimes on his record, responsible for annihilating three of the Holy Lateran's Executor Maniples.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Holst Tyfindale.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: You knew...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Yes, I knew. What I can find out, others can too.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: This is your final warning—

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Your identity is no longer a secret, Gerald.

steps.name: Veteran Lateran Commando
steps.text: Target structure confirmed.

steps.name: Veteran Lateran Commando
steps.text: Hard to believe the Sarkaz would really want to live in an abbey of ours.

steps.name: Young Lateran Commando
steps.text: Ready to move in?

steps.name: Veteran Lateran Commando
steps.text: No rush. We'll wait for the order.

steps.name: Veteran Lateran Commando
steps.text: Let's wait and see. We have the area surrounded.

steps.name: Veteran Lateran Commando
steps.text: Same as that Sarkaz team we nabbed earlier...

steps.name: Veteran Lateran Commando
steps.text: Not a single one of them is getting away.

steps.name: Young Lateran Commando
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I got some food. It's not much, but it's better than nothing.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Sorry, Serpilia... I'm not hungry...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Well, I'll leave it here. You might start to feel hungry in a bit.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Gratias, Serpilia...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: What for?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Nothing in particular... I just wanted to thank you.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Eat up and go to bed if you really want to thank me. I get off earlier that way.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: R-Really? Then I'll go to sleep...

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Sorry, I can't sleep...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I figured.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Are you sure you should be here? I'm feeling much better now... what I mean is... you don't have to stay with me if you don't want to.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Watching you is my job, girl. I'm not exactly a saint.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I won't run away.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Who knows? The better a girl behaves, the more you have to keep an eye on her.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Do you know what those black horns on your head mean? Do you know what's waiting for you when you're brought back to Laterano?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I... No, I don't.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Of course you don't. You can't empath with me, can you?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Oh, don't look like that. I was just trying to scare you a little. His Holiness is pretty kind, all things considered. No need to worry too much.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I'm not worried.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Whatever punishment I receive, I deserve...

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: What's that sound? Is there someone outside?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Whatever it is, it's none of your business.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Stay put. I'll check it out.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Strange. There's nobody here.
You're really letting your guard down. It hasn't been that long.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: The way you talk still makes me want to punch you.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I'm wondering how you operated in Victoria. Did you spend all your time making enemies for Laterano, Oren?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I resent that characterization. No one takes his job more seriously than me.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Speaking of job, you're ready on your side, aren't you, Serpilia?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Maybe?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I need a less ambiguous answer.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: We move at dawn, if there are no complications.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (Strange... Serpilia hasn't come back yet?)

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (Things seemed to have calmed down outside...)

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: (Wh-What's that sound?)

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: S-Serpilia? Is that you?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Oh! Mmph...

steps.name: Low Male Voice
steps.text: Shh.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: It's me.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Raimund?!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Come with me, Fortuna.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Finally outside.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Why are you here, Lemuen?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: There was a bit of trouble. I ran into someone unpleasant and let him get away... it sounds even worse when I put it that way.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I came because I heard a commotion over here.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm surprised you would make a threat like that.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Threat?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Wasn't it?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Then what did you mean?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I was only telling the truth. Correct judgment is based on the truth of the present situation. I don't need to threaten anyone.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I think I get it...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: But there is nothing more unpredictable than people. Even we fail to understand our own thoughts sometimes, and it's not unusual for our actions and thoughts to contradict one another.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Experience tells me that things rarely develop in the most logical way.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Setting that aside... the situation is more complicated than I expected.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: We need to exchange information, Federico.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You mean the monster we saw was the missing Sarkaz by the name of Hyman?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: The state that you saw her in was different from what I saw. And if that's the case...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: She has gone from being impossible to communicate with, demonstrating no capacity for thought beyond feeding instinct, to being able to communicate in a limited manner.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Evolution.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: That is a reasonable hypothesis.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: She has undergone a transformation. During a mission, I read about a religious cult that operates on the Iberian coastline.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: The Church of the Deep.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You seem to know a lot about them, Federico. Have you seen similar creatures on previous missions?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Rarely.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: But you have. That makes things easier to explain.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I had reason to read up on it a while ago... we may be working with the Iberian Inquisition concerning that cult.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: They've caught His Holiness's attention. I didn't expect to run into them here...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: It's a difficult problem.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Difficult and dangerous... I doubt I would've gotten the upper hand if that visitor was trying to do more than slow me down.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: This is irritating... I really need to get back to form. Even Serpilia will start looking down on me at this rate.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Back to the situation at hand, are you sure you should have told Gerald all that?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: He has a right to know.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Alright. What's the plan now?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Investigate.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Fires don't start on their own. Something is not right with the fire at the sacrarium.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: And the flower... No, I can't be sure yet.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: First, I need to find what caused the fire.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Sorry to wake you at this hour.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: It's okay. A lot of us couldn't sleep anyway.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: I've let everyone know. We can leave at any time.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: But didn't you say we were leaving in the morning? What changed?

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Is it because of the fire?

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: I guarantee you it wasn't Raimund who did it. We don't need to—

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: No, I don't suspect him.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: We have a situation. I'll explain later. But we can't wait until morning.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Still no word from the team we sent out?

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: No. It's strange. They might have run into trouble.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Should I take a few guys and check it out?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: No, we'll go together. Make sure everyone sticks together. No one wanders off on their own.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I'll scout ahead. Have the old folks come with me. You take the rear guard with Raimund, alright?

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Something's not alright. I can see it on your face.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: What's going on? You're anxious. Why?

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Because of the Laterans?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Nothing gets past you.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: You're always cautious, Reed.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Stop. That's not my name anymore.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Sorry, I just...
Gerald cannot finish his sentence.
He realizes why his old friend could tell something was wrong at a glance. He realizes he had his hand on the hilt of his dagger.
He is turning from Gerald the Hunter to the mercenary he once was.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Sorry. It felt too much like our Kazdel days.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Maybe I'm overthinking it, but I have a bad feeling about this. Call it a hunch, but we should leave as soon as possible.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Yes, as soon as possible. Take the ones who are ready. We go now.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Like I said, you're the boss. Your call.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: But the last time you had a hunch, it was about finding a place and having a better life.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: We'll find it. I swear.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: I believe you.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: You found this place for us.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I hope it goes smoothly.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I'm sorry, Eileen, but I can't take you this time.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Will you blame me for it?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: What would you think if you could see this?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: It's me, Gerald.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Are you busy?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: There's something you should know...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Wow, that old man is intimidating, isn't he?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: This mission has gotten seriously complicated.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Sarkaz, a fallen angel, and a mad abbot... give me a break.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: And I'm here with Federico, of all people... is that a good thing or not?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Just in case...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Oren, it's me.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Are you gonna do it? You've got the guys there, right?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I suggest you look into this Bishop Stefano. Something's not right with him. It could be dangerous.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: A hunch?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Maybe... I have a bad feeling about this abbey. Well, I guess that's not the right way to put it... it's bad because things aren't that bad.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: You've been here longer than I have. Don't you feel it?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: How could there be a place where everyone works so hard, yet feels no hope at all?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: That's such a sad thing.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: So, I told Raimund about Delfina and Fortuna, not knowing that he didn't know.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: He got very worked up. I'm concerned.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Gerald...? Are you okay?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I'm fine. Don't worry.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: It's not your fault. I just didn't have the chance to tell him.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Where's Raimund?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: He ran out after asking me about Fortuna. He said he was going to get her back.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: They have Laterans guarding Fortuna. Are you sure about this?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: The Sankta won't allow it.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Raimund was born here. Things are different out there. He doesn't understand our relationship with the Sankta.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: I remember, you've said that relations between the Sankta and Sarkaz are...

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Bad.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: It might not have been so bad if we were all just civilians...

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Won't Raimund be in danger?!

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I'll find him. Thanks for telling me.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: There isn't much I can do...

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: I'm beginning to think you were right, Gerald. You should leave this place.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Go now. It's the right choice. Don't... don't wait until tomorrow!

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: That's the plan.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: You seem anxious, Clément... did something else happen?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: I'm fine. I'm just... today has been quite a day. It's a little too much.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Go, Gerald. You were right. You shouldn't stay here.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Something's off about you, Clément. Calm down. You—

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Boss! We have a problem!

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: We went the opposite way from the scout team, as you had ordered, and we saw troops approaching the abbey!

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Troops?

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Laterans! Sankta and Pontifica Cohors!

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: I fought them many times. I'd know 'em from a mile away!

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: They're going to surround us!

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: They never intended to let us go!
Gerald draws his fingers back with a start.
A moment later, he realizes that it's because his fingertips are too cold, so cold that the leather sheath seems to be burning.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Clément.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: I'm here. What do we do...?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Don't worry.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I've been running for too long. This is just putting things back the way they should be... all will be settled.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Tell us what to do, boss.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: We're prepared to fight.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Thank you for spending all these years with me, all of you.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Don't talk like that.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: What are you doing, Gerald? What are you doing?!

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: P-Put down that knife! Calm down!

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I'm perfectly calm, Clément..
The Sarkaz exhales, clutches the dagger, and pulls it out from its sheath.
It burns.
For an instant there, he had difficulty holding onto his old friend.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: My mind has not been so clear in a decade.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: If only blood can end it all, then there's only one thing left to do.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Don't worry. The blood of Sarkaz is not shed lightly.
